# agent-exec-sandbox

> Bounded command executor for agents in Go: allow-listed absolute executables, env allow-list, timeout, output caps and a concurrency limit, stdlib only Go module `github.com/Trysac/u126-agent-exec-sandbox`, package `agentexecsandbox`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
